items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: A very sensitive, one of the most sensitive musical drummers that I ever played with. His name was Denzil Denzer Best.

ctx.x: One thing I want to ask you and didn't ask you was who was in that -- who was in the band with Hawk when you were in that band? Who else was in that band? Can you remember? Who was the drummer?

A very sensitive, one of the most sensitive musical drummers that I ever played with. His name was Denzil Denzer Best. And there was this great bass player who I told you about who I'd played with and met earlier in my life in Minnesota, Minneapolis, Minnesota. Oscar Pettiford.
